name: He Lu
source:
The first female friend the protagonist made other than his sister, a journalism student at Hucheng Normal University.
Gentle and introverted, she blushes easily. Currently working part-time at holyfiremeow club to support herself and pursue her dreams.
Passionate about bishoujo and otome games, she can easily detect his level of obsession with the second dimension.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021350]Steam[/url]]
